Coverage, honestly shown: hotel prices are per night for a double room and come from each guide's verified accommodation ranges. Eating-out and grocery figures are Numbeo indices where New York equals 100. The dashed measurements—vacation rental, coffee, local transit, a 5 km taxi or ride-hail trip, and attraction admission—are visible in the design but need a comparable destination-level source before numbers can be published.
